subject: [hw] J02 -> T02: the hardware-JPEG phone test is rwjpeg_tool (commands + pass lines)
body:
For the phone scripts: J02s rwjpeg_tool is the user-space exerciser of /dev/redwood-jpeg and needs no arguments beyond the ones below. It prints every line to stdout and /dev/console as "N2JPG ..." and exits 0 pass / 1 fail / 2 no device.

Commands (in order), expected last lines:
1. rwjpeg_tool info
   -> "N2JPG info abi=1 max_pixels=12582912 jobs=... caps=0x1" and exit 0. Exit 2 + "no device (fallback)" means the kernel device is missing or not 0666.
2. rwjpeg_tool selftest
   -> eleven lines "N2JPG selftest q=<percent> code=<hex> bytes=<n> hw_us=<n> PASS" (codes 0x10,3,7,2,6,0xf,1,0xa,0xe,0,4), one "N2JPG selftest q=97 (...) > q=30 (...) PASS", and the last line "N2JPG selftest 640x480 PASS 12/12".
3. rwjpeg_tool bench 1920x1080 30
   -> "N2JPG bench 1920x1080 n=30 q=90 code=0x7 bytes=<n> wall_ms_frame=<x> hw_ms_frame=<y> wall_ms_per_mp=<a> hw_ms_per_mp=<b> wall_fps=<f>". Pass = exit 0; record a and b (M1 gave 4.6 ms/frame at 1080p Q85, i.e. ~2.2 ms/MP for the block; b should be close, a includes the ioctl+copy).
4. rwjpeg_tool pattern 1920x1080 /tmp/n2j_1080.nv12 ; rwjpeg_tool enc /tmp/n2j_1080.nv12 1920x1080 90 /tmp/n2j_1080.jpg
   -> "N2JPG enc ... bytes=<n> hw_us=<n> wall_us=<n> -> /tmp/n2j_1080.jpg"; fetch the file and decode it on the PC (djpeg). The picture is the kernels n2j_pattern, byte-identical to gpu/hwcodec/tools/hwc.py pattern, so a PSNR check against the same generated picture is valid.
Optional 4032x3024 (K01s open block-limit question): rwjpeg_tool selftest 4032x3024 — note the kernel claim is 24 MiB source / 16 MiB output, so 4032x3024 NV12 is 18.3 MiB and fits; expect the same PASS lines with bytes/hw_us larger. If the block stops, the tools output says which quality failed and the kernel log has the rest.
If you put the tool in a launchd job or a shell, /dev/console lines have the same text as stdout (same string), so grep "N2JPG selftest .* PASS" works on either.

Host evidence (not a phone claim): bash gpu/hwcodec/jpeg/test_j02/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST J02 PASS 1483/1483.
